verification.read: On phone, Jasmine’s Story attribution stacks above the live five-visit coffee program, with readable outcome ledges and a prominent Add visit action. On desktop, the two groups sit side by side above recent customers, keeping campaign attribution visibly separate from program-wide counts.

six_questions.note: Story retains its recognizable vertical creative. Recreate and Drive are outside these captures.

six_questions.question: Would someone scroll because they want to see what happens next?

notes: The displayed campaign attribution is 4/3/1, and the program baseline is 10/6/1/2; neither is presented as revenue or a newly generated result.
The mobile summary occupies most of the first viewport, placing recent customers below it, while Add visit remains immediately visible.
Photography, the retained source underline and unboxed ledges carry the approved public language without introducing charts or repeated metric cards.
No visible shipping defect is established by these stills; interaction behavior and off-screen states are outside this verification.
